CAVEAT on the hang rows: 60s is triage.py's TIMEOUT, not a proof of
non-termination. The unbounded claim rests on the source: under NDEBUG
the loop guard at ScalarReplAggregatesHLSL.cpp:2994 expands to `do {
(void)(local); } while (0)`, so nothing stops RewriteForScalarRepl's
`while (!V->use_empty())` re-selecting the same use forever.
